topics: 说说你对地方服务的看法
title: Sharing views on local services
titleZh: 说说你对地方服务的看法
summaryZh: 苏格兰政府邀请公众填写问卷；公众意见与地方议会、工会等组织的讨论共同帮助确定改革下一步。

sentences.text: The Scottish Government wants to hear what people think about local government and possible changes.
sentences.zh: 苏格兰政府希望听取人们对地方政府及可能改革的看法。

sentences.text: On 13 November 2026, it announced an online questionnaire for members of the public.
sentences.zh: 2026年11月13日，政府宣布推出一份面向公众的在线问卷。

sentences.text: People can share their views on how local government is organised now.
sentences.zh: 人们可以谈谈自己对当前地方政府组织方式的看法。

sentences.text: They can also say what is most important to them when local government changes.
sentences.zh: 他们还可以说明地方政府改革时自己最看重什么。

sentences.text: The questions ask about possible problems and opportunities, not just the good points of change.
sentences.zh: 这些问题询问可能出现的问题和机遇，而不只是改革的优点。

sentences.text: People can send their answers through the online platform until Friday, 11 December.
sentences.zh: 人们可以通过在线平台提交回答，截止日期为12月11日星期五。

sentences.text: This questionnaire is part of a three-month programme of discussions about local government reform.
sentences.zh: 这份问卷是为期三个月的地方政府改革讨论计划的一部分。

sentences.text: Ministers are also talking to organisations, including Scotland’s 32 local councils and trade unions.
sentences.zh: 部长们也在与包括苏格兰32个地方议会和工会在内的组织交谈。

sentences.text: They want to explore ways to improve public services.
sentences.zh: 他们希望探索改善公共服务的方法。

sentences.text: The government will consider the views and evidence before the next stage of its work.
sentences.zh: 政府将在下一阶段工作之前考虑这些意见和证据。

sentences.text: Future changes will also need careful work on staff, property and how services are provided.
sentences.zh: 未来的改革还需要仔细考虑人员、财产以及服务的提供方式。

sentences.note: can + 动词原形表达可以做什么；until引出截止时间。
will + 动词原形说明接下来打算做的事，不代表已经完成。

questions.text: What local service would you like to improve?
questions.zh: 你希望改善哪项地方服务？

expressions.text: I would like better public services.
It is important to listen to local people.
expressions.zh: 倾听当地居民的意见很重要。
